name: Acidic Absorption
description: When this unit possesses a <color=#8679e8>Corrosion</color> buff, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

name: Burn Drain
description: When this unit has a <color=#e67129>Burn</color> buff, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

name: Chain Acid Swamp
description: If an enemy is afflicted by Corrosion debuff(s), increases critical damage against them by <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.

name: Close-Range Shooting
description: Damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> when distance to the enemy target is less than or equal to <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color>.

name: Complementarity Plan
description: For every <color=#f26c1c>2000</color> points of <color=#f26c1c>healing</color> or <color=#f26c1c>shield</color> applied to allies by Support Dolls, gain <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>Complementarity Plan</color>.

name: Confectant Resonance
description: If this unit's has <color=#f26c1c>2 or more</color> points of Confectance Index at the start of the round, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>25%</color> until the end of the round.

name: Corrupt Arc
description: Increases Electric and Corrosion damage and their critical rate by <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.

name: Electric Drain
description: When this unit has an <color=#d4ae08>Electric</color> buff, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

name: Firepower Overmatch
description:
At the start of battle, gain <color=#f26c1c>10 stacks</color> of <color=#3487e0>Firepower Overmatch</color>.
Firepower Overmatch:
Damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>3%</color>, critical damage is increased by <color=#f26c1c>2%</color>. Stacks up to <color=#f26c1c>50 times</color>. Remove <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> for <color=#f26c1c>each tile</color> moved.

name: Focused Phalanx
description: When shielded, attacks ignore <color=#f26c1c>20%</color> of the target's defense and critical damage is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

name: Freeze Drain
description: When this unit has a <color=#42cce0>Freeze</color> buff, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

name: Light Penetration
description: Light Ammo ignores <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> of target's defense.

name: Mounting Synergy
description: For every <color=#f26c1c>1 allied unit</color> within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color>, damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>6%</color>.

name: Overpressure Rupture
description: Sentinel-class Dolls' critical damage is increased by <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.

name: Putrid Cold Wave
description: Increases Corrosion and Freeze damage and their critical rate by <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.

name: Speedy Offensive
description: For every <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> moved, damage dealt is permanently increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>. Maximum of <color=#f26c1c>10 stacks</color>.

name: Sustained Offensive
description: For every <color=#f26c1c>1 instance</color> of fixed damage taken by an enemy, all damage dealt by allied units is permanently increased by <color=#f26c1c>2%</color>. Maximum of 15 stacks.

name: Undaunted Spirit
description: <color=#f26c1c>Each time</color> a Bulwark-class Doll takes damage, gain <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>Undaunted Spirit</color>.
